expectations.text: Explains a self-liquidating offer: thank-you/sales page product that recoups ad cost (e.g., $100 ads, 100 leads, 10% buy $10 = break even)
Explains break-even day using follow-up (e.g., 5% buy initially, another 5% by day 3)
Cites the $1 per name per month list-value estimate and/or break-even month logic (e.g., $3 lead at $1/month = month 3)
Mentions typical lead cost of $1-$3 in Brunson's market
Applies the math to the user's $2 per lead
Notes numbers are estimates and/or that follow-up/relationship increases value per name
expectations.evidence: Says numbers are worked examples, back-end follow-up
